Cilios.name: Cilios
Cilios.publicNotes:
The majority of mummies were created by cruel and selfish masters to serve as guardians to protect their tombs from intruders. The traditional method of creating a mummy guardian is a laborious and sadistic process that begins well before the poor soul to be transformed is dead, during which the victim is ritualistically starved of nourishing food and instead fed strange spices, preservative agents, and toxins intended to quicken the desiccation of the flesh. The victim remains immobile but painfully aware during the final stages, where its now-useless entrails are extracted before it's shrouded in funerary wrappings and entombed within a necromantically ensorcelled sarcophagus to await intrusions in the potentially distant future. While it's certainly possible to use other methods to create a mummy guardian from an already-deceased body, those who seek to create these foul undead as their guardians in the afterlife often feel that such methods result in inferior undead-the pain and agony of death by mummification being an essential step in the process.

Regardless of the method of their creation, mummy guardians are more than just physical shells of flesh and bone-they retain fragmented, distorted versions of their minds, with only enough memories of their living personality remaining to fuel their undead anger and jealousy of those who yet live. Este burning rage only intensifies over the centuries of waiting within a crypt for the chance to actually act, and thus when most mummy guardians are awoken by tomb robbers or adventurers, they stop at nothing in pursuit of glorious slaughter.

While many cultures practice mummification of the dead for benign reasons, undead mummies are created through foul rituals, typically to provide eternally vigilant guardians.

Darkmantle.name: Darkmantle
Darkmantle.publicNotes:
Estos dark blue or black mollusk-like criaturas have a similar appearance to an octopus, save that they have only six tentacles, all of which are connected by a thick leathery shroud. While darkmantle aren't a particularly good climber, they excel at clinging and can clutch onto a cave roof for days, patiently waiting to ambush any prey that walks below them with a disorienting blob of darkness. When clinging to a cave roof, and with their bulbous red eyes closed down to squints, darkmantles in ambush look similar to stalactites. Their preferred hunting method works best on criaturas without darkvision, so they frequent ruins aboveground or shallow caves not far from the outside world. When darkmantles sense prey, they shed darkness down onto their prey before dropping away from the ceiling to flap quickly down to their victim, whereupon these beasts clutch and squeeze with their thick, muscular tentacles. Despite the shape of darkmantles, their bodies's texture is more like thick leather or even rubber-they can't cause daño with their spike-shaped bodies by dropping down onto other criaturas.

Darkmantles have a swift life cycle-their young grow to maturity in a matter of months, and most of these criaturas die of old age after living for only a few years. As a result, generations of darkmantles quickly accrue, and over the years, they've developed a similarly rapid propensity to adapt to new locations. Aquatic caverns, for example, might be infested with darkmantles that can swim instead of fly; on the other hand, icy caverns would've led to darkmantles that developed white or pale blue colorations, and these specimens might produce blasts of obscuring fog instead of darkness. The deepest, darkest reaches of the Darklands are rumored to host darkmantles of incredible size, capable of smothering multiple human-sized victims simultaneously. Estos deep-dwelling darkmantles have the capacity to shed more powerful darkness that can plunge even criaturas with darkvision into inky blackness- darkness in which these deep-dwelling criaturas can, of course, still see well within.

Grick.name: Grick
Grick.publicNotes:
The wormlike gricks terrorize the caverns and tunnels in which it dwells, lying in wait near heavily traveled underground passages or subterranean cities for the chance to reach forth from the darkness and take its prey. Those laid low by a grick are rarely consumed on the spot. Instead, gricks haul back fresh food back to their lair in a tight burrow or high on a cavern ledge, where they consume their spoils in small bites at the gricks' leisure.

The origin of gricks is unknown. Even though these criaturas have a rudimentary INTELLIGENCE, they don't have any social structure to speak of. Most gricks are encountered alone. Even on those occasions when unfortunate travelers meet multiple gricks in small groups, those gricks don't appear to communicate or work together; each instead attacks an individual target and retreats with its prize as soon as it manages to bring down an opponent. Capable predators, gricks also have a strangely arma-resistant hide that makes them especially dangerous to the unprepared. Many novice adventurers have fallen to grick attacks merely because they couldn't daño these criaturas with their non-magical armas. Those familiar with gricks (especially dwarves, morlocks, and xulgaths) know the best strategy for dealing with them when one lacks access to magic armas is to fall back and wait for more powerful or magical reinforcements.

Gricks rely on their dark coloration and ability to CLIMB walls to keep them out of sight until they're ready to spring an ambush. On occasions, when food becomes scarce in a particular area, gricks have been known to travel to the surface and roam the wilderness in search of prey, but they make these sojourns almost always out of necessity, lasting only as long as it takes them to find entrances to new subterranean lairs. Estos criaturas prefer darkness and the comfort of a ceiling overhead; they avoid the open sky and go to great lengths to keep the cover of trees, low clouds, or buildings between them and the empty gulf overhead.

Some Darklands societies have tried to recruit gricks as guardians or even beasts of burden, but their INTELLIGENCE-while middling at best-is more than enough for them to stubbornly resist and even resent attempts at "training." The best most societies can manage is to keep a grick guardian happy by making sure it remains well-fed and comfortable.

Id Ooze.languages: (no puede hablar ningún idioma); telepathy 60 ft
Id Ooze.publicNotes:
Not all oozes are mindless predators capable of little more than ambushing and consuming prey. The id ooze is a thinking, calculating criatura with the capacity to carry out complex plots and plans-not always to secure a meal. Left to its own devices, an id ooze is just as content to spend decades or even centuries in introspective philosophical pursuits as it is to crawl through the underground rivers and moist caverns it prefers to call home.

An id ooze can derive sustenance from the consumption of organic material, but without easy access to plants or animals to eat, they can subsist in a state of semi-hibernation for centuries while slowly absorbing residual psychic energies in locations that have been host to powerful emotions, such as long-standing temples that once hosted generations of worshippers, settlements that endured horrific wars or devastating disasters, or even just the home of a powerful occult spellcaster whose thoughts left marks upon the walls long after they moved on.

An id ooze prefers water but is equally at home on land. The slimy criatura appears as a patch of water until it attacks, when its gelatinous body piles up on itself to form a single pseudopod that strikes like an angry snake.

Fallo The PC treats the room as difficult terrain and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}. A PC who's already prone suffers a critical failure instead.

Obscured Pitfalls.description: Un layer de disembodied eyes obscures un pitfall en el suelo que's either deep enough for un human a caer into, o narrow enough a cause un painful caer.
Obscured Pitfalls.disable: Este hazard can't be disabled, merely avoided.
Obscured Pitfalls.stealth: Either DC 18 o 0 si el eyes covering un area que obscures un pitfall son destruido.

action->Pitfall.name: Pitfall
action->Pitfall.description:
Desencadenante A criatura walks into a large pit's square;

Efecto The triggering criatura falls into the pit but can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18] salvación to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{GRAB an Edge} to avoid falling. On a failure, a criatura falls 20 pies into an eye-filled pit. The eyes cushion the fall so the 20-pies fall inflicts only @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:fall-daño] daño, but they also completely obscure vision; a character is effectively blind as long as they remain in the pit. The walls of the pit are slick, though a character can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{CLIMB} them with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:25] check.

action->Trip.name: Derribar
action->Trip.description:
Desencadenante A criatura walks into a small pit's square;

Efecto The triggering criatura must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:18] salvación or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} (on a critical failure, the criatura also twists its ankle and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} until it receives any amount of healing).

Pendulum Blades.name: Pendulum Blades
Pendulum Blades.description: Several swinging pendulums mounted con razor-sharp blades extend de el techo y slice into el sala below.
Pendulum Blades.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] a jam el gears y prevent el trampa de being activated

action->Swinging Blades.name: Swinging Blades
action->Swinging Blades.description:
Desencadenante Este trap must be manually activated by a criatura adjacent to the southwest gear stack;

Efecto Blades swing down to strike at all criaturas in area F2 before wrenching to a frozen halt against the opposite walls. All criaturas in the central part of this room take @Damage[(6d6 + 3)[slashing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]).

Phantom Mold.name: Phantom Mold
Phantom Mold.description: Un burst de pale gray spores sprays into el air.
Phantom Mold.disable: @Check[survival|dc:18] a remove el mold sin triggering el spores

action->Spore Burst.name: Spore Burst
action->Spore Burst.description:
Desencadenante The moldy books are moved or the mold takes any daño;

Efecto All criaturas within 10 pies of the mold patch are exposed to phantom mold spores.

action->Phantom Mold Spores.name: Phantom Mold Spores
action->Phantom Mold Spores.description:
Any penalties to Perception from this poison persist for 1 hora after the poison's duration ends (this effect can be removed before then by any effect that neutralizes poison);

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:18];

Duración máxima 4 asaltos;

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño;

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño, and the victim takes a -1 penalización de estado on visual Perception checks as strange shadows and flittering movement appear in their peripheral vision;

Etapa 3 as stage 2, but a -2 penalización de estado.

Pit of Toil.name: Pit of Toil
Pit of Toil.description: As ghostly, ectoplasm-dripping figures of dwarves work all around, the body of a living criatura within the pit begins to ache with the pains of countless hours of back-breaking toil.
Pit of Toil.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:21] (experto) to shame the pit by miming skilled artistry, or @Check[religion|dc:18] (entrenado) to exorcise the haunt.
Pit of Toil.routine:
(1 action; divine, necromancy) As the dwarves continue to chant and grasp at the living, the pit infuses all living criaturas inside it with the ache and pain a body endures after hours of constant toil. Each living criatura in the pit must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18|traits:divine,necromancy,damaging-effect] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura suffers no ill effect and is thereafter immune to the pit of toil's routine.

Éxito The criatura suffers no ill effect.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[4d6[void]] daño and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado}.

action->Invite Toil.name: Invite Toil
action->Invite Toil.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura enters the pit

Efecto The surrounding dwarven shapes begin to chant in Dwarven, encouraging newcomers to join them as they grasp for them with their cold, incorporeal hands. The pit of toil rolls initiative.

Spike Thrower.name: Spike Thrower
Spike Thrower.description: Slats en el techo open y pepper el camara below con long, metal spikes fired de el spring-loaded tubes.
Spike Thrower.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] a jam el gears y prevent el trampa de being activated

action->Throw Spikes.name: Throw Spikes
action->Throw Spikes.description:
Desencadenante Este trap must be manually activated by a criatura adjacent to the southwest gear stack;

Efecto The spike thrower makes a ranged attack against each criatura in the central part of area F2.

Tallow Guardian.name: Tallow Guardian
Tallow Guardian.publicNotes: Un tallow guardian typically appears as un vaguely humanoide-shaped mass de tallow o wax, su surface constantly melting, running down su cuerpo, y then hardening solo a be reabsorbed into el central mass. El tallow guardian's face seems constantly en el verge de melting into un shapeless blob, yet el unsettling construct puede still sentido el world around ello con ease.

action->Molten Wax.name: Molten Wax
action->Molten Wax.description: All daño persistente de fuego caused by a tallow guardian comes from globs of molten hot tallow that cling to its foes. Este tallow cools automatically after 4 asaltos, or immediately if the criatura takes any daño de frío; once the tallow cools, the daño persistente de fuego ends.

action->Melt.name: Melt
action->Melt.description: If a tallow guardian takes any daño de fuego, its body melts somewhat and becomes even more difficult to daño. Until the end of its next turn, its resistance to slashing and daño perforante increases to 10, and its resistance to daño contundente increases to 5.

action->Slowed by Cold.name: Slowed by Cold
action->Slowed by Cold.description: If a tallow guardian takes any daño de frío, it loses the benefits granted by melt and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

action->Encase.name: Encase
action->Encase.description:
The tallow guardian attempts to pull a Medium or smaller criatura it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} into its body. The tallow guardian attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check opposed by the grabbed criatura's Reflex DC. If it succeeds, it encases the criatura with its body. An encased criatura is grabbed, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}, and must hold its breath or start suffocating. It takes @Damage[2d6[fire]] daño from the tallow guardian's molten hot wax when it's first encased, and at the end of each of its turns while it's encased.

A tallow guardian can only have one encased criatura at a time; if a tallow guardian encases a new criatura, a previously encased criatura is forced out of its body into an adjacent square of the criatura's choice.

An encased criatura can break free with a successful DC 22 check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. An encased criatura can attack the tallow guardian, but only with ataques sin armas or with armas of light Bulk or less. The tallow guardian is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the attack. If the tallow guardian takes 7 or more bludgeoning or daño cortante from an encased criatura, the criatura wrenches itself free. A criatura that gets free by either method can immediately breathe and exits the tallow guardian's space, but it continues to take @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] daño from the molten wax that clings to its body.

If a tallow guardian is destroyed, any criatura it has encased is automatically released as the guardian's body collapses into a shapeless mound of tallow.

The Disciples.name: The Disciples
The Disciples.publicNotes:
Un unrisen es un mangled conglomeration de splintered huesos, decaying organs, y rotting flesh, created cuando un ritual such as resurrect goes catastrophically wrong. Immense care debe be taken, for si el ritual es un critical failure, un unrisen puede be el result—as many un ritualist tiene learned a su horror.

Unrisen son barely intelligent, aware solo de el agony constantly inflicted by su flawed creation y su resentment for el vivo. They tend a ataque el casters involved en el botched ritual first before lashing out at everyone else around them. Though un unrisen's twisted form es unrecognizable as el intended objetivo de el resurrection, su wordless howls son often disturbingly similar a el deceased's voice. Si un unrisen es destruido before ello puede rise de nuevo, ello's reduced a un handful de metallic blue-green salts referred a as essential salts.

action->Lifesense 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]
Lifesense 30 pies

action->Rise Again.name: Rise Again
action->Rise Again.description: If the Disciples is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe by means other than daño de fuego, disintegration, or its resurrection vulnerability, it returns to unlife at the start of its next turn. It has 45 Puntos de Golpe and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} in the space in which it was destroyed. The Disciples can't be returned by this ability again for 1 hora.

action->Agonized Howl.name: Agonized Howl
action->Agonized Howl.description: The unrisen howls in pain at its cursed existence. Las criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[6d8[mental]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect]). The unrisen can't use Agonized Howl again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Agonized Howl]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Awful Approach.name: Awful Approach
action->Awful Approach.description: The unrisen reshapes its grotesque form to move swiftly. It Strides twice. Any living criatura that can see the unrisen during this movement must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} on a critical failure). Este is a mental and visual effect. The unrisen can't use Awful Approach again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Awful Approach]]{1d4 rounds}.

The Last Crucible.name: The Last Crucible
The Last Crucible.description: Magically hardened sheets de obsidian drop down over el sala's exits mientras el machinery dentro de taps into wells de magma a begin spewing lava-y monsters-into el maze.
The Last Crucible.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28] (experto) to disable the main pressure plate at area H4a and deactivate the trap entirely (this causes the obsidian walls to retract up into the ceiling as well), @Check[thievery|dc:25] (entrenado) to disable one of the three lava spouts, or @Check[athletics|dc:28] (entrenado) to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{FORCE OPEN} a fallen obsidian wall
The Last Crucible.hpDetails: UR 29 to smash a 5-ft-sq hole in the wall; Spout H 13; Spout HP 20 (UR 10)
The Last Crucible.reset: The Last Crucible deactivates and resets 10 minutos after it has no target criaturas (because the criaturas either left area H4 or died). Any thoqquas that still live sense the magma river at area H6 and eventually make their way north to that area to swim away.
The Last Crucible.routine: (3 actions) La trampa loses 1 action per disabled spout each turn. On each action, a different spout located at one of the three areas marked H4c spews a gout of lava at the closest non-thoqqua target in its line of sight; these spouts use magical sensors that have darkvision and a Perception DC of 25. Originally, agents of the abbot would come through here after the trap was triggered, deactivate it, and clean out the hardened blobs of lava and dead bodies that remained, but the amount of time it would take for this trap to clog tunnels with cooled lava makes tracking that slow accretion over the course of this adventure unnecessary.

action->Drop the Wall.name: Drop the Wall
action->Drop the Wall.description:
Desencadenante Four or more Small or larger criaturas walk onto the pressure plate at area H4a;

Efecto A magically hardened sheet of obsidian drops down like a portcullis in the western and northern entrances to this room that lead to areas H3 and H5, respectively. Any criaturas standing in one of these squares takes @Damage[(4d6 + 4)[bludgeoning]] daño from the falling wall (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]) and then decides what side of the wall they want to be on. At the same moment, four thoqquas that have spent centuries in hibernation awaken and emerge from vents into area H4b. La trampa then rolls initiative, as do the thoqquas.

strike-melee->Lava Gout.name: Lava Gout
strike-melee->Lava Gout.description: Este attack has no multiple attack penalización.

Thoqqua.name: Thoqqua
Thoqqua.publicNotes:
Thoqquas are cantankerous criaturas of fire and slag. Their bodies generate incredible heat that allows them to burrow or melt through most surfaces, even solid rock. Thoqquas are native to the vast ash deserts and lava fields of the Plane of Fire. There, they consume ore and minerals, which their furnace-like bodies then smelt into armor plates that grant the criaturas their armored forms.

Estos criaturas' foremost body segment tapers into a straight, hornlike beak that glows with a blistering heat. Steam and smoke constantly hiss from their joints, and from a distance, thoqquas can be mistaken for strange metallic constructs. Adult thoqquas are 5 pies long and weigh 200 pounds.

Thoqquas are dangerous to approach-they attack without thinking when startled or frustrated. If they don't immediately chase away intruders within their territory, then they might gradually come to view that area as property and even guard it. Mephits seem to understand this curious thoqqua thought process, occasionally brokering deals with the magma worms. The mephits claim that the mountain- sized ancestors of modern thoqquas were servants of the elemental lords and dug the first volcanoes in the young worlds of the Material Plane. Estos "progenitor worms" then retired to the worlds' cores, where their heat warms the planets even today. Thoqquas on the Material Plane do congregate around volcanoes-though whether this tendency is to protect a mineral-rich food site or sacred place, or simply out of comfort, depends on the thoqqua in question.

action->Molten Body.name: Molten Body
action->Molten Body.description: A thoqqua's body is hot enough to melt stone. A criatura who grabs a thoqqua, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} by a thoqqua, or critically fails a melee Golpe with an ataque sin armas or agile arma takes @Damage[1d4[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic]).

action->Reactive Thrash.name: Reactive Thrash
action->Reactive Thrash.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the thoqqua's reach hits the thoqqua with a melee Golpe

Efecto The thoqqua instinctively thrashes into the attack, pressing its molten hot scales forward. The attacker must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:15] salvación.

Éxito crítico The attacker is unaffected.

Éxito The attacker takes @Damage[1d4[fire]] daño.

Fallo The attacker takes @Damage[2d4[fire]] daño.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the arma used to Golpe the thoqqua becomes broken unless the arma is made of metal, has more than 10 Hardness, or is resistant to or immune to fire.

action->Critical Ignition.name: Critical Ignition
action->Critical Ignition.description: On a impacto crítico with a body Golpe, a thoqqua inflicts an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] daño.

action->Starving.name: Starving
action->Starving.description: A thoqqua feeds on a combination of raw stone, ore, and heat. When denied these nourishments, a thoqqua won't perish from starvation, but it does grow less armored as it's forced to absorb and weaken its armored body plates. A starved thoqqua's ARMOR CLASS is reduced by 2, but it gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia on all tiradas de ataque.

Toxic Furnace.name: Toxic Furnace
Toxic Furnace.description: El smoking furnace begins a hiss y click, y su vents swivel y adjust a spew toxic fumes en el direction de intruders.
Toxic Furnace.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:25] (entrenado) to render one of the vents useless, or @Check[athletics|dc:25] to wrench and bend a vent until it no longer functions
Toxic Furnace.hpDetails: Furnace UR 28, Vent Hardness 10, Vent HP 18 (UR 9)
Toxic Furnace.reset: La trampa se reinicia después de 1 minuto, during which it sees no criaturas to target.
Toxic Furnace.routine: (3 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each disabled vent. On each of the trap's actions, a vent spews a gout of boiling toxin at a living criatura in sight of it. It can't target a single criatura more than una vez por asalto, so if there aren't enough viable targets for all 3 actions, the trap loses those unspent actions.

action->Spew Toxins.name: Spew Toxins
action->Spew Toxins.description:
Desencadenante A visible living criatura enters the room, or a Stealthy criatura fails to remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} from the toxic furnace with a @Check[stealth|dc:25] check (the trap's sensors have darkvision and lifesense);

Efecto One of the toxic furnace's vents swivels to aim at the triggering criatura and then spews a gout of boiling toxin at el objetivo. The toxic furnace then rolls initiative.

Trapped Elevator.name: Trapped Elevator
Trapped Elevator.description: An oversized cauldron rigged as an elevator suddenly drops 30 pies if it's overloaded.
Trapped Elevator.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (entrenado) to lock the releasing mechanisms in place, or @Check[crafting|dc:20] to rig additional supports for the cauldron (this activity requires 10 minutos of work)
Trapped Elevator.reset: Las criaturas can still fall down the shaft even after the cauldron is released, but the cauldron must be reset manually.

action->Release the Cauldron.name: Release the Cauldron
action->Release the Cauldron.description:
Desencadenante More than one Medium or more than two Small criaturas are inside the cauldron when it is activated to lower;

Efecto The cauldron releases from its anchor points on the chains and drops 30 pies to area E1; any criaturas within take 15 points of daño contundente in the fall. A criatura can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{GRAB an Edge} to avoid falling by clinging to a chain.

Ulizmila's Cauldron.name: Ulizmila's Cauldron
Ulizmila's Cauldron.publicNotes:
While Ulizmila is long gone, her animated cauldron remains a dangerous guardian of the hut. The mindless construct lurches to life and attacks anyone who dares to enter, pursuing intruders all the way to the clearing's edge before returning to its place inside the hut. When the cauldron attacks, it "bites" at enemies by snapping at them with its hinged lid while its inner surfaces swiftly heat up to cook anything Small it can "gulp" down.

Granted a semblance of life through the use of rituals or other strange magic, animated objects take many forms and serve a variety of uses. A few examples of typical animated objects are listed below. Many of these criaturas serve as guardians, surprising unsuspecting adventurers when they suddenly attack. Others serve as idle distractions for the exceptionally rich, simple servants created to handle odd jobs, and the like.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 9).name: Construct Armor (Hardness 9)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 9).description: Like normal objects, an animated object has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated object is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to the listed value.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Small, @Damage[2d6[fire]], Rupture 3

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Unsafe Stairs.name: Unsafe Stairs
Unsafe Stairs.description: The rickety stairs groan and strain alarmingly if a Small or larger criatura ascends them.
Unsafe Stairs.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:16] a quickly jury-rig some supports a prevent el stairs de collapsing

action->Collapse.name: Desplome
action->Collapse.description:
Desencadenante A Small or larger criatura attempts to CLIMB the stairs;

Efecto The stairs attempt a @Check[flat|dc:8] (if a Small criatura triggered the hazard) or a @Check[flat|dc:16] (if a Medium or multiple Small criaturas triggered it). On a failure, the stairs collapse. All criaturas on the stairs fall and take @Damage[(2d6 + 3)[bludgeoning]] daño from the collapsing rubble (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]).

Vargouille.name: Vargouille
Vargouille.publicNotes: Vargouilles son scavengers de el swamps de Abaddon, where ellos flop y flap through strange y haunted skies en constant search de fresh souls a torment. In este daemonic nightmare realm, vargouilles play un role similar a que de un raven o vulture, although ellos augment these roles con un malevolent delight en causing pain y anguish que no scavenger bird could ever hope a match. Un vargouille es larger than un human cabeza, typically between 12 y 20 inches high con un 15- a 35-inch wingspan. Mientras vargouilles aren't natives de el Material Plane, ellos puede be found there nevertheless, occupying graveyards, antiguo battlefields, o anywhere one puede find remnants de death y decay.

action->Tenacious Wounds.name: Tenacious Wounds
action->Tenacious Wounds.description: A criatura who takes daño de veneno from a vargouille must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] salvación or be cursed. The cursed criatura can't regain HP except via magic, and anyone Lanzando un conjuro to heal the criatura must succeed at a DC 18 counteract check or the healing has no effect. The vargouille's counteract rank is equal to its criatura level. A criatura can attempt a new @Check[fortitude|dc:18] salvación una vez al día (typically when it makes its daily preparations) to end this curse. The curse ends automatically if the criatura is healed to maximum HP.

action->Vargouille's Kiss.name: Vargouille's Kiss
action->Vargouille's Kiss.description:
Requisitos The vargouille is adjacent to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, or willing humanoid criatura

Efecto The vargouille nuzzles up against a helpless or willing humanoid criatura in a parody of a lover's kiss-the criatura must then attempt a tirada de salvación or begin an unsettling transformation into a vargouille. The sickened, stupefied, and unconscious conditions from Vargouille's Kiss don't improve on their own until the disease is cured. Este disease can't progress in stage as long as the victim is in sunlight or in the area of a 3rd-rank or higher light effect.

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Etapa 1 no ill effect (2 hours)

Etapa 2 victim's hair falls out, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (2 hours)

Etapa 3 victim's ears elongate into winglike shapes and their teeth grow tangled and sharp, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (2 hours)

Etapa 4 as Stage 3, but the victim falls unconscious (2 hours)

Etapa 5 death, and the victim's head transforms into a new vargouille that detaches from the body and flies off to spread evil on its own.

action->Vargouille's Shriek.name: Vargouille's Shriek
action->Vargouille's Shriek.description:
The vargouille distends its jaw awfully and emits an unnerving shriek. All criaturas within 60 pies who can see and hear the vargouille must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] salvación.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Vargouille's Shriek for 24 horas.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} until the end of its next turn.

Fallo crítico The criatura is paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

weapon->Flying Talon.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ucz1WdBA0Ma34OsS]

Este arma consists of a three-pronged barbed hook attached to a length of chain. It can be used as a melee arma to stab at foes or hurled as a ranged arma. Some kobolds are particularly fond of using flying talons, especially as a sort of badge of office above those who serve them.

action->Intimidating Retreat.name: Intimidating Retreat
action->Intimidating Retreat.description:
Requisitos Ygrik is adjacent to at least one enemigo and at least one ally;

Efecto Ygrik commands an adjacent ally to fight harder and threatens dire punishment if the ally fails to obey; that ally gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to its next melee Golpe tirada de ataque, as long as that attack is made before the start of Ygrik's next turn. Ygrik then Strides up to his Velocidad and gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. He must end this movement in a space that isn't adjacent to any enemigo.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Ygrik deals an additional 1d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.
